name: cavemio-notification-inbox
title: Notification inbox
description: The bell, done properly: its own circle grows into the inbox, new notifications swing it and roll the count, and read ones fold out of Unread.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The bell is a button that says how many are unread ("Inbox, 2 unread") and opens a dialog; focus goes to the active tab and returns to the bell on close.
- Unread and All are a tablist (arrows switch). Each row is a button or link with ", unread" read out when it is; the dot is a toggle button named for what it will do.
- New notifications, read changes and archives are announced in a status region outside the dialog.
- The archive button appears on hover and focus with a mouse, and is always visible on touch screens.
- Reduced motion opens the inbox in place, without the swing, glides or folds; the counts still change.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: value
props.description: – · Controlled notifications, newest first: { id, title, body?, at, read?, actor?, href? }.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: – · Every arrival, read change and archive.

props.name: subscribe
props.description: – · Feeds new notifications; call push with one or many. Duplicates by id are ignored.

props.name: onRead
props.description: – · Saves read state; the change shows at once and is undone if this throws. Without it there is no Mark all read.

props.name: onArchive
props.description: – · Archives; the row leaves at once and comes back if this throws. Without it there is no archive button.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: – · Runs when a notification is opened, after it's marked read. Items with href are links.

props.name: loadMore
props.description: – · Older notifications for the All tab; an empty list hides Show older.

props.name: align
props.description: "end" · Which edge of the bell the inbox lines up with.

props.name: label
props.description: "Inbox" · Names the bell and the dialog.

features.title: The bell grows into the inbox
features.description: The bell’s circle eases into the inbox panel, and folds back the same way when it closes.

features.title: New ones arrive visibly
features.description: subscribe() feeds new notifications. The bell swings, the count rolls, and an open inbox fades the new row in while the rest glide down.

features.title: Unread and All
features.description: Opening a notification reads it. In Unread, the row lingers for a moment and then folds away.

features.title: Read and archive save safely
features.description: A change shows at once, and is put back if your onRead or onArchive function throws.

features.title: Mark all read
features.description: One button reads everything, with a drawn check, and the counts roll to zero.

features.title: All caught up, and older ones
features.description: An empty inbox says so with a drawn check, and loadMore brings in older notifications for All.

states.title: open
states.description: The bell's 36px circle grows into the inbox (460ms, size and corners together), lined up with the bell's edge and nudged back on screen; the bell fades as the list fades in 100ms behind. Escape, the cross or a click outside folds it back and returns focus to the bell.

states.title: arrive
states.description: subscribe() pushes a notification: the bell swings from its top (720ms, ±16° settling), the badge springs in or its count rolls, and in an open inbox the row fades in on top while the rest glide down.

states.title: read
states.description: Opening a notification (or its dot) marks it read: the dot shrinks to an outline, the title eases to grey; in Unread the row stays 900ms, then folds away. onRead failing puts it back.

states.title: mark all
states.description: Mark all read → Marking → All read with a drawn check; every unread row reads and folds out of Unread together, and the counts roll to zero.

states.title: archive
states.description: The archive button (shown on hover or focus, always on touch) removes the row: it folds away where it stood and the rest glide up. onArchive failing brings it back.

states.title: empty
states.description: "You're all caught up" opens by height with a check that draws itself in a thin line circle.
